description: List your recent scans: id, the niche you described, status and timestamps. Use it to find a session_id you no longer have.

niche_contains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the niche input, to find sessions on a topic (e.g. 'walnut').

offset.description: Skip this many sessions before returning, for paging through history. Default 0.

status_filter.description: Optional scan status, such as cp1_awaiting_story, cp2_awaiting_angle, complete, or failed.

name: niche_list_sessions
title: List sessions
